sentences.japanese: 彼ほど平々凡々たる主人公は珍しい。
sentences.english: A protagonist as plain and ordinary as him is rare indeed.

sentences.japanese: さまざまな才能に恵まれて、なんでもそつなくこなす姉にとって、平々凡々たる俺の存在はひどく許せないものらしい。
sentences.english: For my multi-talented sister, able do anything with ease, it seems that my commonplace self is something whose existence she finds very hard to forgive.

sentences.japanese: あぁ……、若かったとはいえ、しょうもない凡ミスだ。
sentences.english: Ahh ... well I was young but what a stupid mistake.

sentences.japanese: 凡そ人間に限らず、あらゆる動物は、異性に対つて、意識的無意識的に、「性的示威」を行ふものである。
sentences.english: As a rule, not only in humans, but also in animals, "sexual display" occurs, consciously or unconsciously, towards individuals of the opposite sex.
